items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos, no readable labels. A small American full bathroom about 5 by 8 feet, freshly renovated: a white alcove tub with a glass panel instead of a curtain, white subway tile to the ceiling, a floating light oak vanity with a white top and a round mirror, a wall sconce on each side, a small hexagon mosaic floor, a recessed shelf above the toilet with folded towels, a plant. Bright daylight, airy and calm.
